children: Basis bids for soft red winter wheat shipped by barge to US Gulf Coast export terminals were lower following the US Thanksgiving holiday.

The US dollar was on track for a modest weekly gain, while Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Friday and posted weekly gains as investors returned from the Thanksgiving holiday and flocked to hard-hit AI-linked shares. (FRX/)
A stronger US dollar tends to make US exports less attractive to foreign buyers.
CIF SRW wheat barges loaded in November were bid at 55 cents over December wheat futures
, a fall from the previous session.
CIF SRW wheat barges loaded in December were bid at 65 cents over December futures, also down from the day before.
Basis bids for corn and soybeans were mostly unchanged in the US Midwest as futures prices jumped in an abbreviated trading session, spot checks showed on Friday. (GRA/PM)
Strong US export sales supported corn futures
on the Chicago Board of Trade, while soybean futures
rallied on spillover support from surging soymeal prices, traders said.
